solutions.check: grid and clues read from the FT's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; every fifteensquared answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Toiler disposed to belie his nature

definitions.text: Toiler disposed to belie his nature

indicators.note: disposed in the sense of arranged or set out afresh, so the letters of the clue's first word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A hard worker inclined to act against his own character.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearranging TOILER under 'disposed' gives a word for idling, which is exactly how a toiler would belie his nature, so the whole clue is both wordplay and definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To dawdle aimlessly is the opposite of hard work, so a toiler doing so contradicts his industrious character.

clue.text: Identified boy embracing pretty girl

indicators.note: embracing means the boy's word wraps its arms round the girl's word

parts.note: a boy is a lad
a belle is a beautiful girl

explanation.surface: A boy is recognised as he hugs a pretty girl.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tagged with a label has been named or marked out, a direct synonym of identified.

clue.text: Ahead of where Greens suggest the danger of petrol lies

definitions.meaning: leading a race or contest, in front of the field

definitions.text: where Greens suggest the danger of petrol lies
definitions.meaning: environmentalists warn that leaded petrol is harmful, so the hazard lies in the metal lead

explanation.surface: Environmental campaigners point out where the hazard of fuel is found.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase is read once as being in front, and once literally: the danger lies in the lead added to petrol.
explanation.definitionFit: Being out in front of rivals is the idiomatic sense of leading, the same as ahead.

clue.text: They see and show audible approval

indicators.note: audible means the word for approval is heard rather than written

parts.note: ayes are votes of approval, as in 'the ayes have it'

explanation.surface: Onlookers watch and voice their agreement.
explanation.walkthrough: AYES, votes in favour, sounds like the organs of sight; 'show' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The organs of sight are what do the seeing, so they are literally the things that see.

clue.text: Hairstyle set before the engagement party

indicators.note: set before means the hairstyle word is placed ahead of the next piece

parts.note: a bun is hair coiled at the back of the head
an engagement is a battle or fight

explanation.surface: Someone arranges their hair ahead of an engagement celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Engagement party' reads as one phrase, but 'engagement' is a fight and 'party' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea party with buns, or a rowdy gathering, is called this informally in Britain.

clue.text: Opens gifts after the holidays?

parts.note: reads like unwrapping presents, but describes emptying the cases or bags brought back from a trip

explanation.definitionFit: Taking things out of luggage on returning from a holiday is what someone does when they empty a case.

clue.text: Shrewd fielder in sticky leg trap

parts.note: fly is slang for shrewd or knowing
a catcher is a fielder who takes catches, as in baseball or cricket

explanation.surface: A canny cricketer stationed in the leg-side catching cordon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leg trap' is a cricket field placing of close catchers on the leg side; here it means a sticky strip that snares insects by their legs.
explanation.definitionFit: A sticky paper strip hung up to snare insects is called by this name, trapping them by the legs.

clue.text: Escort follows the van in front

definitions.meaning: to escort is to accompany for protection
vanguard and rearguard: the one at the back follows the van leading the way

explanation.surface: A protective escort trails the vehicle ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: The van is the vanguard at the front of an army; the rearguard follows it.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who escorts a person for protection is acting as their protector, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Continue to nurse this common subject of strain

parts.note: to nurse is to tend
on means continuing, as in carry on

explanation.surface: Keep looking after an often-injured body part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tend on' reads as continuing to nurse; split it differently for the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: These cords joining muscle to bone are often strained or pulled in sport injuries.

clue.text: Dramatic beginning formulated at once

indicators.note: formulated means put together in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A theatrical opening devised immediately.
explanation.definitionFit: The first section of a play is where the drama begins, its opening part.

clue.text: Articles from the picnic basket in the meadow

parts.note: butter is one item you might pack for a picnic
a cup is another item in the picnic hamper

explanation.surface: Things taken out of a hamper during a picnic in a field.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase supplies two items, joined to give a yellow flower; 'in the meadow' is where it grows.
explanation.definitionFit: A common yellow wild flower of grassland, so it is found growing in a meadow.

clue.text: Long time coming to the point

parts.note: a year is a period of time
N, north, is a compass point

explanation.surface: A lengthy period finally getting to the crux.
explanation.definitionFit: To long for something is to desire it intensely, a verb synonym.

clue.text: I was first out, but refused to admit it

indicators.note: out signals the letters are disordered or knocked out of place

parts.note: led means was first, in front

explanation.surface: Someone was first to be eliminated but denied it.
explanation.definitionFit: Telling untruths rather than owning up is refusing to admit the facts.

clue.text: It's dicey to play in a game of tick

definitions.meaning: risky and uncertain in outcome

definitions.text: play in a game of tick
definitions.meaning: in tick or tag you touch another player and then run away

explanation.surface: Joining a children's chasing game is risky.
explanation.walkthrough: Tick is the British name for the playground chasing game called tag elsewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A situation whose outcome is very uncertain is precarious, which is what dicey means.

clue.text: Transfix in rehearsal

definitions.meaning: to transfix is to pierce right through, as with a sword
a quick practice performance of a play

explanation.surface: A gripping practice session.
explanation.definitionFit: Piercing someone with a blade is the literal sense, and a practice performance is the theatrical one.

clue.text: Kill someone and carry out

definitions.meaning: to put to death lawfully
to perform or implement a plan

explanation.surface: Murder someone and take the body away.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: putting a condemned person to death and performing a task.

clue.text: Holy area in outskirts of Samarkand

indicators.note: in means the area word sits inside the other letters
outskirts are the outer edges, so the first and last letters of the city

parts.note: an acre is a unit of area

explanation.surface: A sacred site on the edge of the Silk Road city.
explanation.definitionFit: Something consecrated or revered as divine is holy, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Calm and painless death

parts.note: painless means easy
going is a euphemism for dying

explanation.surface: A peaceful, pain-free end to life.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone relaxed and placid in temperament is described as calm, an adjective synonym.

clue.text: Set out to get a fiancee

definitions.meaning: meant or planned to do
one's betrothed, the person one is engaged to marry

explanation.surface: Someone sets off to win a bride.
explanation.definitionFit: Planned is one sense, and a betrothed partner is the noun sense of the same word.

clue.text: Newspaper leader

parts.note: a leader is an opinion column, but here it is the person heading the paper

explanation.definitionFit: The person in charge of a newspaper is its head, and also writes the leader column.

clue.text: Frauds may be covered in the press

definitions.meaning: dishonest schemes for making money

definitions.text: may be covered in the press
definitions.meaning: reported in newspapers, or literally kept in a wooden press to stop tennis bats warping

explanation.surface: Swindles might be reported by the newspapers.
explanation.walkthrough: Old wooden tennis bats were stored in a press to keep them flat.
explanation.definitionFit: Swindles are frauds, and the same word names the strung bats used in tennis.

clue.text: Tramples relative underfoot?

parts.note: steps means treads, the sense of trampling
on describes what lies beneath the foot as one treads

explanation.surface: Someone crushes a family member beneath their feet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tramples underfoot' is read as treads on; joined, it gives a family member by remarriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A spouse's son from an earlier marriage is a relative by marriage.

clue.text: Cattle drives

definitions.meaning: young castrated male bovines
directs a vehicle or course

explanation.surface: Livestock are herded along.
explanation.definitionFit: Bullocks raised for beef are cattle, and guiding a car is driving it.

clue.text: She turns a gate-crasher over to the US secret service

indicators.note: turns means the battering word is read backwards

parts.note: a battering ram crashes through gates
the CIA is the American intelligence agency

explanation.surface: A woman hands an intruder over to American intelligence.
explanation.walkthrough: A gate-crasher here is a battering ram, not a party intruder.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's given name, which the clue stands for with a pronoun.

clue.text: It's taken out in wool-gathering

definitions.meaning: removed or extracted
daydreaming, lost in thought

explanation.surface: Something is extracted while someone daydreams.
explanation.definitionFit: Extracted is one sense, and being preoccupied or absent-minded is the other.

clue.text: Pen has the French way of writing

parts.note: a pen is an enclosure, as is a sty for pigs
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A writer's pen has a French manner of composition.
explanation.definitionFit: The manner in which someone writes is their characteristic style.

clue.text: Look round to leg in play

parts.note: O is round in shape

indicators.note: in play signals the letters are moved about

explanation.surface: A cricketer glances towards the leg side while the ball is live.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leg' and 'in play' suggest cricket, but leg is just anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: To stare at someone with lustful interest is to look at them.

clue.text: Biblical town subject to inflation

definitions.meaning: the Phoenician port mentioned in the Bible
a wheel's rubber casing is pumped up with air

explanation.surface: An ancient town affected by rising prices.
explanation.definitionFit: The Phoenician port appears in Scripture, and the British spelling names a pneumatic wheel covering.

clue.text: An animal that's shy backs up

parts.note: coy means shy

indicators.note: backs means the word is turned round

explanation.surface: A timid creature retreats.
explanation.definitionFit: A large South American aquatic rodent is an animal.

clue.text: Archaeopteryx, say, one in good time for breakfast

definitions.meaning: an ancient bird, an early example of a bird

definitions.text: one in good time for breakfast
definitions.meaning: someone who rises early, as in catching the worm

explanation.surface: A prehistoric bird is first in line for its morning meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaeopteryx was a very primitive bird, and the idiom names a person who rises early.

clue.text: It's very hard yet maths revision is essential

indicators.note: revision means reworking, so the letters are revised into a new order

explanation.surface: Maths revision is hard but necessary.
explanation.definitionFit: This purple gem is a variety of quartz, a hard mineral.

clue.text: Acted evasively, being naturally guarded

definitions.meaning: avoided committing oneself
surrounded by a living fence of shrubs

explanation.surface: Someone was cagey, by temperament cautious.
explanation.definitionFit: Avoided commitment is one sense, and enclosed by a hedge is the literal one.
